prompt:

All interior pixels of the figure must be opaque flat black, with no eye, hair highlights, jewel, clothing seams or other interior detail. Keep the background genuinely transparent. Exactly the same single bust outline, nothing else. No outlines beyond the existing contour, no glow, no text, no symbols, no question mark.
